mu_name_from: MuMain's MODEL_TITAN_* (_enum.h: MODEL_BOOT + 45), loaded from Data/Player/BootMale46.bmd by the index-plus-one rule. MU's number 45; ours is *Male46.
why_this_one: The missing-gear audit, 2026-10-23: the last sets missing at drop levels 93-132, which Kanturu's monsters reach (the user: 'we need to build all kanturu weapons and armors'). Titan is the Dark Knight's.

stats.note: The item's own row: OpenMU's Season 6 initialiser (0.75 and 0.95d have none).

sheet_from: MuMain/src/bin/Data/Player, decoded with pipeline/decode_texture.py under MU's own names, lower-cased (an .OZT beside its .OZJ takes _t): navy lacquer plate edged in silver and gold; skinClass301 the knight's own face under the helm.
material_note: painted_steel with the cast grain for the plate, the shading painted on, as the other sets.
material_overrides_note: painted_steel's own grain is a blade's, brushed along V; on plate it drew vertical streaks (studio, 2026-10-04). plate_steel's cast grain instead, shallow for the gloss.
effects_note: MuMain has no render arm for MODEL_TITAN_* (no glow, no chrome pass).
